subject: Cleardata onboarding: PO routing & invoicing exception
messages:
From: Mika Tanaka <mika@cleardata.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@cleardata.io
Date: 2026-10-18T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding: Redwood listing & PO routing (Cleardata)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get Cleardata listed across Redwood's marketplace lanes. A couple of procurement items we need to align on before our go-live:

- Invoice routing: Our legal / finance group requires invoices to go to Cleardata EU Holdings (VAT ID available) for EU customers.
- Marketplace PO: GCP marketplace requires vendor tax information and a vendor ID mapping for invoicing.
- Timing: We need an initial PO window to match our go-live on Nov 5.

I've attached our W9 for the US entity (Cleardata_W9.pdf) and can share VAT docs if needed. Can you confirm Redwood's PO flow for multi-entity sellers and whether an exception is possible to allow invoicing to our EU entity while listing in the global marketplace?

Proposed next steps: quick procurement touchpoint + mutual action plan so we can capture paperwork and expected PO dates.

Best,
Mika
Mika Tanaka
Commercial Ops | Cleardata Inc
procure@cleardata.io

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Mika Tanaka <mika@cleardata.io>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-18T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Redwood listing & PO routing (Cleardata)

Hi Mika — welcome, and thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Vanessa and Kimberly from procurement to map PO routing and any marketplace-specific constraints.

Quick notes from our side:
- Standard flow: marketplace listings typically route invoices to the seller entity tied to the vendor ID (AWS/Azure/GCP). That vendor ID is what triggers finance to pay the seller.
- Exception path: we can support a procurement exception for invoicing to a different legal entity, but it requires:
  1) Finance approval for cross-entity payment (VAT + tax holdbacks reviewed)
  2) A signed procurement addendum to the marketplace terms (legal)
  3) Clear mapping from vendor ID -> invoice remit-to (ops to configure)

Vanessa/Kim — can you confirm the typical lead time for an exception (finance + legal review) and what documents you need from Cleardata beyond the W9? Mika, if you can share VAT registration and a short statement of remittance instructions that will speed review.

I can also create a short mutual action plan once we have the doc list and target PO date (Nov 5 is tight but we'll try to prioritize).

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Mika Tanaka <mika@cleardata.io>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-18T11:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Redwood listing & PO routing (Cleardata)

Thanks Jordan — adding the procurement intake details. Mika, welcome. A few practical items to unblock quickly:

1) Required docs for exception review: VAT registration cert (EU), invoice remit-to legal name, registered address, and banking instructions (IBAN preferred). If you have a copy of the master services agreement or marketplace signing entity, attach that too.

2) Marketplace differences (short):
   - AWS Marketplace: invoice typically tied to the AWS vendor ID; we can map remit-to but AWS billing rules are strict about tax docs.
   - GCP Marketplace: GCP often supports invoicing to a different remit-to via vendor payout configuration, but it takes configuration lead time.
   - Azure: similar to AWS; requires the seller's tax profile aligned with the vendor account.

3) Timeline & lead times: finance + legal exception review typically 5–8 business days if we have all docs. Configuration in marketplace portals is another 3–5 business days.

I've uploaded our PO mapping template to share how we configure vendor -> remit-to; attaching the working file: Marketplace_PO_Mapping.xlsx (snapshot). Mika, please fill columns A–D for your vendor IDs and remit-to entity and return.

Next steps: Mika to send VAT docs + completed PO mapping template; Kimberly will kick off finance review; Lauren will intake the legal addendum queue for a quick review.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Mika Tanaka <mika@cleardata.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@cleardata.io
Date: 2026-10-19T07:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Redwood listing & PO routing (Cleardata)

Thanks Vanessa — attached are the VAT registration (Cleardata_EU_VAT.pdf) and bank instructions (Cleardata_Bank_Instructions.pdf). I've also completed the vendor mapping for GCP and AWS (vendor IDs included).

Quick clarification: Cleardata cannot accept consolidated US invoicing for EU sales due to internal revenue recognition rules — invoices must be remitted to Cleardata EU Holdings for EU customers. We appreciate the exception path described; can you confirm whether Redwood will need a signed addendum or if a PO with a remit-to override will suffice?

Also: proposed dates — if procurement/legal can start review today, can we expect a PO issuance window by Oct 29? That would give our GTM team a short buffer before Nov 5.

Best,
Mika

Attachment: Cleardata_Bank_Instructions.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Mika Tanaka <mika@cleardata.io>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-19T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Redwood listing & PO routing (Cleardata)

Mika — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the attachments.

We will proceed with an exception pathway and aim for the Oct 29 PO window. Action items:
- Kimberly: kick off finance review with the attached VAT + bank docs, confirm whether any tax withholding will be required. (Jira: PROC-2121)
- Lauren: please prepare a short procurement addendum template and confirm whether a signed addendum is required or if the PO remit-to override is sufficient for our legal and audit records.
- Vanessa: update the vendor mapping in the marketplace portal for GCP/AWS and note the remit-to override.

Mika — once finance confirms there are no blocking tax holds, we will generate an initial PO that points invoices to Cleardata EU Holdings. If legal asks for an addendum, we can run a parallel DocuSign to keep to the Oct 29 target.

I will also attach the HubSpot deal and create a short mutual action plan in the deal notes (link included).

Appreciate the responsiveness — will follow up when finance/legal have sign-off.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
